description: This Java source file defines the 'Staff' entity class within the 'org.apache.fineract.organisation.staff.domain' package. It includes fields representing staff attributes, such as name, contact information, roles, office association, and image. The class provides methods for creating instances from JSON commands, updating attributes, and accessing related data. It is a core part of the staff management domain model in the Fineract project.

classes.name: Staff
classes.description: Entity class representing a staff member with attributes such as name, contact info, office, role, status, and image, along with methods for creation, update, and role-based access.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a new Staff instance from a JSON command and associated Office, extracting staff details from the command parameters.

methods.name: organisationalRoleData
methods.description: Returns the organisational role data as an EnumOptionData object based on the role type.

methods.name: changeOffice
methods.description: Updates the office associated with the staff member.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates staff attributes based on a JSON command, tracking and returning the actual changes made.

methods.name: emailAddress
methods.description: Returns the email address of the staff member.

methods.name: officeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the office where the staff member works.

methods.name: displayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the staff member.

methods.name: mobileNo
methods.description: Returns the mobile number of the staff member.

methods.name: office
methods.description: Returns the Office object associated with the staff.

methods.name: setImage
methods.description: Associates an image with the staff member.

methods.name: isLoanOfficer
methods.description: Indicates whether the staff member is a loan officer.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Indicates whether the staff member is active.

methods.name: identifiedBy
methods.description: Checks if the staff member is the same as another staff object based on ID.
